resource: UTF-8 bytes of one journal text in domain 16, template counters filled in
allocation_impact: Measured 463. A journal entry whose worst case (each template counter as 20 bytes, the longest i64) is longer does not load; a longer text fails closed in the codec.
boundary_tests: max=1024: a 1,024-byte text encodes and decodes
max+1: a 1,026-byte text (two-byte characters) fails closed
notes: QUEST-GATE-0 §9 (QUESTGATE0-RL-08 payload bytes); the Tibia Global text itself arrives with QUEST-CONTENT-2. Measured over content/quests/definitions (58 storyline quests with missions, 529 missions) from each mission's name and the longest journal text reference length, a template counted with 20 bytes per placeholder.
